14. [Maximum mark: 21]
The functions $f$, $g$ and $h$ are defined by
$f(x)=1+\mathrm{e}^x$, for $x\in\mathbb{R}$,
$g(x)=\frac{1}{x}$, for $x\in\mathbb{R}/\{0\}$,
$h(x)=\sec x$, for $x\in\mathbb{R}/\left\{\frac{2n+1}{2}\pi,\ n\in\mathbb{Z}\right\}$.
(a) Determine the range of the composite function $g\circ f$. [3 marks]
(b) Determine the inverse of the function $g\circ f$, clearly stating the domain. [4 marks]
(c) (i) Show that the function $y=(f\circ g\circ h)(x)$ satisfies the differential equation
$\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=(1-y)\sin x$.
(ii) Hence, or otherwise, find $\int y\sin x\,\mathrm{d}x$, as a function of $x$.
(iii) You are given that the domain of $y=(f\circ g\circ h)(x)$ can be extended to the whole real axis. That part of the graph of $y=(f\circ g\circ h)(x)$, between its maximum at $x=0$ and its first minimum for positive $x$, is rotated by $2\pi$ about the $y$-axis. Calculate the volume of the solid generated. [14 marks]
